# Fluent REST Client

A lightweight, chainable (fluent), immutable REST API client built on **Axios** with automatic **Auth & Refresh** management.

## 🚀 Features

- ✨ **Fluent & Immutable Interface**: Clean, chainable, and side-effect-free resource building (e.g., `client.resource('users').id(1).sub('posts').get()`).
- 🛡️ **Safe Mode**: Return `{ data, status, ok, error, headers }` tuples instead of throwing `try/catch` exceptions.
- ⚡ **In-Memory Caching**: Cache GET responses with configurable TTL using `.cache({ ttl: 5000 })`.
- 🔄 **Smart Token Refresh**: Automatic 401 retry with an atomic **request queue** to prevent duplicate refresh calls.
- ⏱️ **Timeouts & Cancellation**: Native support for `.timeout(ms)` and `.signal(abortSignal)`.
- 📤 **Upload Progress**: Track file upload progress easily with `.onProgress(fn).upload(formData)`.
- 📄 **Async Iterators**: Iterate paginated endpoints effortlessly using `for await (const page of resource.paginate())`.
- 📡 **Global Telemetry**: Register global listeners for logging or monitoring (`onRequest`, `onResponse`, `onError`).
- 📦 **Universal & Type-Safe**: Works in Node.js, Web, and React Native with full TypeScript definitions.

## 📦 Installation

```bash
npm install fluent-rest-client axios
```

## 🛠️ Usage

### 1. Initialize Client & Telemetry

```javascript
import { FluentRestClient } from 'fluent-rest-client';

const api = new FluentRestClient('https://api.example.com', {
  onGetToken: async () => localStorage.getItem('token'),
  onSaveToken: async (token) => localStorage.setItem('token', token),
  onRefreshToken: async () => {
    const res = await axios.post('https://api.example.com/refresh', {
      refresh_token: localStorage.getItem('refresh_token')
    });
    return res.data.access_token;
  },
  retries: 3,
  retryDelay: 1000,
  logger: (msg) => console.log('📢 Log:', msg)
});

// Telemetry Listeners (Sentry, Datadog, etc.)
api.onRequest((config) => console.log('🚀 Sending:', config.url));
api.onResponse((res) => console.log('✅ Received:', res.status));
api.onError((err) => console.log('🚨 Error:', err.message));
```

### 2. Safe Mode (No Try/Catch needed)

```javascript
const { data, ok, status } = await api.resource('users').id(123).safe().get();
if (!ok) return console.error('Failed with status:', status);
console.log(data);
```

### 3. In-Memory GET Caching

```javascript
// Serves subsequent requests from cache within 10s (0ms network delay)
const res1 = await api.resource('categories').cache({ ttl: 10000 }).get();

// Manually clear cache when needed
api.clearCache();
```

### 4. Timeouts & Request Cancellation

```javascript
const controller = new AbortController();

const user = await api
  .resource('users')
  .id(1)
  .timeout(3000) // 3s timeout
  .signal(controller.signal) // Connect AbortSignal
  .get();

// Cancel request when component unmounts: controller.abort();
```

### 5. File Uploads with Progress Tracking

```javascript
await api
  .resource('users')
  .id(1)
  .sub('avatar')
  .onProgress((progress) => {
    console.log(`Uploaded ${progress.percent}% (${progress.loaded}/${progress.total} bytes)`);
  })
  .upload(formData);
```

### 6. Paginated Async Iterators

```javascript
// Automatically fetches page 1, 2, 3... until no more items remain
for await (const page of api.resource('posts').paginate({ limit: 20 })) {
  console.log(`Page ${page.page} loaded with ${page.items.length} items`);
}
```
